## v2.3.1

### Fixed and improved

- Reorganized Settings into clearer groups on every device.
- Applied TCP hub, LAN discovery, and Cardputer Adv brightness changes as soon as they're saved, and limited restart prompts to changes that need one.
- Fixed "Settings memory unavailable" errors on Cardputer Adv during busy network activity.
- Improved Cardputer Adv setting inputs, including a number editor for Playback volume and a chooser for Wi-Fi mode.
- Improved Wi-Fi scanning so it recovers after failed connection attempts.
- Fixed screen dimming and keyboard backlight not following saved settings.
- Applied theme and 24-hour clock changes throughout the interface.
- Fixed the Cardputer Adv startup sound sometimes cutting off, and T-Pager alerts playing quieter than the selected volume.
- Kept the saved Wi-Fi setting when a device recovers from repeated failed startups.
- Hardened message links against malformed and spoofed packets.

### Build and compatibility

- Settings are now saved only to internal storage, with or without an SD card.
- Compatible web flasher updates keep identity, messages, and settings. Factory ZIP installations erase them, so back up anything you want to keep.
